concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-adyen-docs-payouts-payout-service-pay-out-to-cards-reconciliation]] — 2026-09-15 Payout Service card-disbursement reconciliation guide joining merchant-report BPPaidOut fees to booked balance-platform Transfer Id amounts; Net Debit is fees only, and booked is not recipient-card receipt proof.
warnings: The guide's Net Debit (NC) is total card-payout fees, not payout amount plus fees; the amount is in the Balance Platform Accounting Report (raw lines 25–32).
The join requires Balance Platform Accounting Report Status booked (raw line 34); this is accounting status, not evidence of external cardholder receipt.
The phrase capture/card payout amount appears in raw lines 32–34 without more capture semantics; do not extend it to payment capture lifecycle.
